app.name: RideX Admin
auth.credentialsHelp: Use the identifier and password for your assigned Admin account. The backend determines your role and permissions.
auth.otpHelp: Verify the OTP issued by the authenticated backend flow for this device.
auth.deviceIdentity: Browser device identity is sent as request metadata only.
auth.noPrivilegeSelector: Admin Type selection does not grant privilege.
auth.testOtpConfig: The backend requested sign-in OTP in TEST mode. RideX TEST login is configured to use identifier and password without ordinary authentication OTP. Check the backend environment configuration.
auth.signOutLocalOnly: You were signed out locally, but the server could not confirm session revocation. Contact an administrator if this repeats.
dashboard.title: RideX operations at a glance
dashboard.description: Backend-authorized operational overview. Live state comes from the locked RideX backend.
dashboard.globalView: Global view: Super Admin can see the entire authorized dataset.
dashboard.scopedView: Scoped view: geographic authorization is enforced by the backend.
dashboard.replayGap: Realtime replay gap detected. Command-center state was resynchronized from the backend.
dashboard.supportDescription: Use Support for unresolved customer or driver issues. Operational changes remain backend-authorized and audited.
common.noMatchingRecords: No backend records match the current search or status filter.
common.customerRestricted: Restricted account status returned by backend
common.customerRestrictedNote: This account is marked as restricted by the backend. No account state has been changed here.
workspace.customers.description: Review customer records and any backend-returned account restrictions. Account changes remain backend-authorized.
workspace.reports.description: Dashboard-backed overview only until an authorized report/export contract is confirmed.
workspace.support.description: Review support cases and any backend-provided timeline. State changes remain backend-authorized.
workspace.otp.description: Review authorized OTP purpose configuration, versions and audit history returned by the backend.
workspace.audit.description: Review actor, action, result and request context returned by the audit API.
workspace.monitoring.description: Review backend-reported health and operational status; missing checks are not synthesized.
support.noTimeline: No case timeline was returned by the backend. Timeline/mutation availability must be confirmed with the support API contract.
support.contractNotice: Internal notes and escalation use case-scoped, audited backend routes. Status/assignment changes stay blocked until changeReason is persisted by the backend, and customer/driver replies stay blocked until explicit case-level scope authorization is verified.
reports.contractNotice: Report catalog, job state, timezone/scope query and export schema have not been verified. Only dashboard-backed metrics are displayed; report and export actions remain unavailable until the report/export contract is supplied and verified against backend source.
errors.invalidCredentials: The credentials are not valid. Check your Admin identity and password.
errors.otpInvalid: The verification code is invalid. Check the code and try again.
errors.otpExpired: The verification code has expired. Request a new code.
errors.otpAttemptsExceeded: Too many incorrect attempts. Request a new verification code.
errors.permissionDenied: You are not authorized to perform this action.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment before trying again.
errors.networkUnavailable: The server could not be reached. Check the connection and retry.
errors.requestTimedOut: The request timed out. Please try again.
errors.serviceUnavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.requestFailed: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.loginSessionMissing: The login response did not include a session. Please contact support if this repeats.
errors.otpChallengeInvalid: The server did not return a valid OTP challenge. Please sign in again.
workspace.deliveryHealth.description: Review realtime freshness and only backend-returned delivery records.
workspace.publicLinks.description: Review public app links and download settings returned by the backend.
workspace.scopeAssignments.description: Review Admin geographic assignment metadata within your authorized view.
auth.adminTypeNote: This selection is an informational login context only. The backend determines your actual role, permissions and scope.
auth.resetRequestHelp: Enter the registered mobile number for your Admin account. A password-reset OTP is required in TEST and LIVE.
auth.resetVerifyHelp: Enter the OTP sent for password reset and choose a new password.
auth.passwordResetSuccess: Password reset successfully. Sign in with your new password.
auth.passwordsDoNotMatch: The new password and confirmation do not match.
reports.catalogDetail: No dedicated report catalog endpoint was found in the reviewed backend source.
reports.jobsDetail: No verified report-job lifecycle or history endpoint was found.
reports.filtersDetail: These values are not sent anywhere. Date/timezone and scoped filters are not sent to the dashboard endpoint and must not be treated as applied.
reports.exportsDetail: No verified permission-scoped export route, output schema or field allowlist was found.
reports.scopeNote: This label describes the session context, not proof that dashboard aggregate counts are geographically restricted.
reports.geographicWarning: Backend review found dashboard aggregate count queries without explicit STATE/CITY predicates for non-Super Admin roles. Do not treat these metrics as regional totals until backend scope enforcement is verified.
reports.noFakeExports: Run report unavailable. No report has been run and no file has been generated or downloaded from this screen.
recovery.noVerifiedBackup: The backend did not report a verified backup for this environment. Recovery must be treated as not ready.
recovery.stale: Showing the last successful recovery status; it may be stale.
recovery.sensitiveStorage: Storage paths and raw backup storage keys are intentionally not shown in the browser.
support.detailLoading: Loading case details and internal notes…
support.noMessages: No conversation messages were returned for this case.
support.attachmentHidden: Attachment reference hidden. Use only a verified time-limited attachment flow.
